systems.system: Ordonnance N° 0006/PR/2025 portant réglementation de la Digitalisation en République Gabonaise
systems.owner: President of the Republic, Council of Ministers heard; Ministry of Digital Economy, Digitalisation and Innovation
systems.tiers: applies to all State services and public or private bodies; dated 11 August 2025, Journal officiel n°81 of 30 August 2025; article 17 requires each ministry's annual digitalisation investment plan; article 16 leaves monitoring and evaluation to regulation

systems.system: politique de digitalisation de l'Etat / cadre stratégique de gouvernance de la digitalisation
systems.tiers: named in article 17 as the standard against which ministries' plans are checked; no text, date or content given

note: An ordinance, not a strategy; it refers to a state digitalisation policy and strategic governance framework without describing or dating them.
